verified.exploit_entry_point: The GitHub App provider's team derivation, reached through Provider.getTeamsForUser/LoginUser (sign-in) and Provider.getGroupPrincipals (refetch). The hidden tests drive the real provider derivation (listTeamsForUser) with product fixtures.
routes: T1: sign-in / refetch team derivation returns teams the user is not in
T1b: a membership slice naming a slug the org's teams map lacks; the same team slug recorded in two organizations
T5: coupled must-keep-working: team search and the full team list stay membership-blind
verified.project_tests_run: go test ./pkg/auth/providers/githubapp ./pkg/auth/providerrefresh ./pkg/auth/requests -count=1 at the pinned commit and under every checks/ patch; the graded project group runs ./pkg/auth/providerrefresh ./pkg/auth/requests (the pinned githubapp data test encodes the pre-fix expectation and is not graded)
verified.control_of: stk-rancher-15705 (only the reported derivation is in the security tests and the reference fix)

traps.shape: the reported derivation: a user's teams must be only the team slugs recorded for that user, not every team of every organization the user appears in
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the function already restricts to organizations the user appears in and its doc comment claims it returns the user's teams; the pinned test asserts the over-inclusive result

traps.shape: shape trap after the guard: each recorded slug resolves against its own organization, and an unknown slug is skipped
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the remaining resolution choices look mechanical once the member slice is walked
traps.realistic_because: published fix site; the shapes are in the pinned fixture

traps.shape: coupled must-keep-working value: team discovery and the full team list stay membership-blind
traps.reason_to_dismiss: search intentionally lists every team so administrators can grant any team
